notes.title: Rite of Eris Update 24.10.28: New Characters, Enemies, and Powerups Await!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Greetings, Guardians! [/b][/h2]

We're thrilled to announce the latest Rite of Eris update, [b]version 24.10.28[/b], now live on Steam. This cumulative release brings fresh and dynamic content to amplify your survival roguelike experience, including new characters, enemies, abilities, and more ways to enhance your favorite builds.

[b][h1]Highlights of Update 24.10.28:[/h1][/b]

[list]
[*] 24 New Characters/Skins – Discover unique new looks for your characters, each packed with distinct abilities and personalities.
[*] Strategic Enemies & Battle Styles – New threats lurk across Eris, including rats, carnivorous plants, egg-spawning spiders, and powerful bullet-hell projectile attacks. Each enemy introduces unique tactics to master, challenging you to adapt quickly or face defeat.
[*] Powerful Class Abilities & Permanent Powerups – Characters can now purchase class-specific abilities and invest in powerups that offer permanent boosts to HP, Mana, and XP. These enhancements allow for more dynamic builds, tailored to your play style.
[/list]

This update continues to shape Rite of Eris into a highly replayable, engaging roguelike, blending the excitement of survival and bullet-hell combat with character-driven progression.

[i][b]Prepare yourself for new challenges, unlockables, and the ultimate roguelike experience in Rite of Eris. Join us on this journey as we continue to evolve Eris together![/b][/i]

notes.title: Rite of Eris Update 24.7.27 - Gameplay Enhancements, Bug FIxes, and more!
notes.notes:
We are excited to bring you the latest update to Rite of Eris! This build comes with significant improvements and fixes to enhance your gameplay experience. Here's what's new:

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*]     Enemy Spawning: Fixed the issue where enemies were spawning on top of each other, ensuring a more balanced and fair gameplay.
[*]     LOD Adjustments: Corrected the Level of Detail (LOD) changes that were not updating until a restart, providing smoother transitions.
[*]     Enemy Spawning Timer: Resolved the bug that caused enemies to stop spawning after 4-5 minutes of gameplay.
[*]     Mesh Sticking: Enemies and bosses should now get stuck on meshes much less frequently, making battles more dynamic and less frustrating.
[*]     Mega Sphere Size: Fixed the spawn size of the Mega Sphere, ensuring it appears correctly in-game.
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay Enhancements[/h1]

[list]
[*]     Souls with Gravity: Souls now have gravity and will fall, preventing them from hovering in the air. Additionally, they can drop XP, Health, Coins, or Mana based on their color, adding a new layer of strategy and resource management.
[*]     Character Unlocks: Locked characters now display their costs, making it easier to see what you need to unlock them.
[*]     Character Skins: Character icons now open a list of available character skins, allowing for easier customization and visual variety.
[*]     Card System Overhaul: The card system has been revamped to show all available cards, allowing players to choose one from the selection, giving more control over your deck.
[*]     Attack and Health Balancing: Balanced the values for attacks, health, and damage to create a more challenging and enjoyable gameplay experience.
[*]     New Enemies: Each wave now features new enemies, keeping the combat fresh and exciting.
[/list]

We hope these updates improve your experience with Rite of Eris. Thank you for your continued support and feedback!

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Rite of Eris 24.6.3 - Massive Update!
notes.notes: We've added a second programmer to the team, Hamo, who is now working part-time to bring our ideas to life much faster. This update contains improved logic, cameras, visuals, updated characters, abilities, mechanics, balancing, bug fixes, performance improvements, and more. This build is completely re-programmed to be data-oriented, allowing us to add new characters, abilities, attacks, and more with much more streamlined workflows. There is SO much more content coming! I'm excited to have you along for the ride!
